caption:
Appearances are easy to polish. Hearts take work.

Sahih Muslim 2564c and Qur'an 26:88-89, read together: faces and wealth are not what is looked at — the heart and its deeds are.

A question to sit with today: what does my heart need?

Save this and come back to it.

📖 Sources
• Sahih Muslim 2564c (Sahih, tr. Abdul Hamid Siddiqui) — sunnah.com/muslim:2564c
Full text: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily Allah does not look to your faces and your wealth but He looks to your heart and to your deeds
• Qur'an 26:88-89 (tr. Saheeh International) — quran.com/26/88-89
• Recitation: Qur'an 26:88-89 — Mishary Rashid Alafasy (EveryAyah.com) — quran.com/26/88-89
